steps.name: Install pinned Rust and iOS standard library
Type check the optional carrier provider for physical iPhone
Check all native bridge files against the simulator SDK
Build and bundle the standard UIKit application
Build and bundle the optional carrier provider
Cache the successfully built UIKit application
Verify native UI, device roundtrips and activation

checks.name: network_path_observed
checks.semantics: network path availability, not Internet reachability

controls.detail: The simulator reports a brightness value but has no writable physical backlight.
This device has no rear torch.
Use the native volume panel. iOS does not provide a general writable system volume property.
Choose an available output in the system route picker.
The native route picker chooses compatible audio/video destinations for the app; it does not enable system screen mirroring.
Low Power Mode is observed from iOS. Change it in the system Settings app.

snapshot.detail: Public UIKit device integrations. Contacts respect the selected access scope; message composition reports the actual system composer outcome. Device controls reflect observed hardware and permissions.

roles.detail: The running device/build does not have an eligible signed Default Dialer entitlement. The standard calling handoff remains available.
Carrier messaging requires the signed entitlement, an eligible iPhone/region and selection as default. The normal message composer remains separate.

checks.name: brightness_read_only
checks.refusal: Screen brightness is read-only in iOS Simulator.

first_retained_observation.boundary: Only the retained samples establish observed runtime state. Earlier Unknown or suspension transitions must not be inferred from portable lifetime tests.

network_scope: Network.framework path availability, not Internet or remote-service reachability.
pixel_analysis_boundary: Decoded current-run screenshot regions and actual native button crops are measured; no general visual parity claim.
readiness_boundary: Shell launch phase to first URL delivery after observing ready; includes launch setup and polling. The existing 240-second budget was retained.

console_driver_begin.liveness_source: Shell kill -0 of its direct simctl launch child; not native application liveness.

console_driver_end.liveness_source: Shell kill -0 of its direct simctl launch child; not native application liveness.

cleanup.boundary: XCTest completed and the shell successfully waited for its owned xcodebuild child. Separate simctl launch child liveness is recorded. Native app termination and simulator deletion were requested but not independently proved by a post-cleanup native PID or simulator inventory; a mounted sample is not a closed-host receipt.
